messages.subject: minor suggestion
parts:
I just discovered the folds.id argument, which is very useful.
A suggestion is to allow cv.folds to be a vector or a single number; then folds.id is not
needed. (This is what rpart does.)

It isn't a significant code change, but makes it more likely that users will find the
argument.

Terry T.
